propositions: The rebar-janitor discovery process does not evaluate whether test assertions can fail when their guarded contracts are violated, leaving oracle-strength gaps undetected.

Concern #12 must be added to discovery.md to systematize detection of contracts whose test oracles accept states the contract forbids (proven via escape_input), and contract-coverage gaps where oracles accept violations.

The antipattern vocabulary exists in code-review-tests.md but is unreachable in non-rebar repos; a portable reference section must be added to patterns.md naming fail-open oracle, fixture-mutates-foreign-state, mismatched-hardening-equivalence, and unstated-policy-oracle.

The schema output at discovery.md:152 hardcodes 'eleven concerns' while concern #12 is added, creating drift between two halves of one artifact that nothing currently detects; a durable oracle test must derive and assert their agreement.

verification.md currently floors test-only findings at prod_impact=none regardless of the guarded contract's severity, allowing weak-test bugs to escape; the floor must re-anchor to the production contract being guarded and require tree-state proof of harm reachability.
